newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha weak as futures lose ground.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha weak as futures lose ground.

text.p: NWE naphtha was weaker on Thursday as futures markets subsided, dealers said.
A U.K. player said he received an offer of a Skikda cargo at high cif +$5 a tonne cif NWE, but said the market was likely to be worth a couple of dollars or more less than that.
Alexandria material was heard still available at high +$4, and a Ras Lanuf cargo was talked at around the same range.
A small heavy Russian piece and a small full-range Russian piece were heard available. Prices were talked under the quoted cif low, but the quality of the naphtha was thought fairly poor.
